title: Slow Cooker Beer Pulled Pork
description: This Sweet Baby Ray's pulled pork is an easy, big-batch recipe for your slow cooker. Serve it with soft buns for the best pulled pork sandwiches ever!
ingredients: 1 (12 fluid ounce) can beer (such as Shiner® Bock)
1 (12 ounce) bottle barbecue sauce (such as Sweet Baby Ray's®)

steps.text: Place pork into the slow cooker. Season with salt, pepper, onion powder, and garlic powder. Pour beer into the bottom of the slow cooker. Cover and cook on High for 1 hour. Reduce the heat to Low and cook until meat is tender and can be easily pulled apart with a fork, 8 to 10 hours.
Remove pork from the slow cooker and shred with two forks. Discard cooking juices. Return shredded pork to the slow cooker and stir in barbecue sauce. Cover and cook on Medium for 1 hour.

video.description: In this video, we'll show you how to make slow cooker pulled pork. Just thoroughly season the pork butt roast, add a can of beer and set it to cook-we recommend starting in the morning for dinner tonight. Shred the pork, toss with a good bottle of barbeque sauce and get ready for an impressive, comforting meal.
